firm_data.firm_description: Nagashima Ohno & Tsunematsu was established in 2000 with the philosophy of addressing legal issues arising out of the increasingly complex global business community by combining the individual talents of our lawyers to offer legal services of the highest quality. Nagashima Ohno & Tsunematsu NY LLP (“NO&T NY”) succeeded Masuda International, founded by Mr. Junji Masuda in 1992.
notable_facts: Established on September 1, 2010, Nagashima Ohno & Tsunematsu NY LLP (“NO&T NY”) succeeded Masuda International, founded by Mr. Junji Masuda in 1992.

email.subject: AI for Nagashima Ohno & Tsunematsu NY, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi there,

Nagashima Ohno & Tsunematsu NY has built a strong reputation handling complex cross-border M&A and joint ventures since 2010. That kind of work demands precision, speed, and absolute client trust, especially across multiple jurisdictions.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on M&A and capital transactions.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
